primary_metric: Per-seed mean accuracy over clean, noise .2/.4/.6, dropout .05/.15/.30, joint (.4,.15)/(.6,.30); report mean over seeds. Primary matched control fixed_joint.
candidate: four additional copies per clean training row; per row per copy theta~Uniform[0,pi/2], sigma=.25 cos(theta), dropout=.25 sin(theta); scaler fit to clean train; RBF SVC C=10 gamma=scale.
control: same clean rows + four copies per row, applying independently drawn Gaussian noise sigma=.25 and pixel dropout p=.25 together; same model, split, scaler.
pass_rule: supported_pilot only if candidate mean primary metric exceeds fixed_joint by >=0.01 and is higher in at least two of three paired seeds; otherwise no_gain. Mechanistic mixed-corruption criterion is separately falsified if arc does not exceed both axis ablations on mean accuracy across the two joint conditions.
prior_art_search: Hendrycks & Dietterich, Benchmarking Neural Network Robustness to Common Corruptions and Perturbations (ICLR 2019): https://arxiv.org/abs/1903.12261
Hendrycks et al., AugMix: A Simple Data Processing Method to Improve Robustness and Uncertainty (ICLR 2020): https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.02781
Shorten & Khoshgoftaar, A survey on Image Data Augmentation for Deep Learning (2019): https://journalofbigdata.springeropen.com/articles/10.1186/s40537-019-0197-0
held_out_evaluation: Run once after all three validation seeds; no threshold or method changes after validation. test outputs immutable and use a fresh path.
